🕵️ Shadow Trader Digest – 04 October 2026


Three under-the-radar events that might quietly move markets this week:



  1. 🇺🇸 Columbus Day holiday — closed
    Wednesday, 07 October · New York Stock Exchange
    US equities dark; bond markets open. Settlement cycles roll to the next session.
    Source →

  2. 🇯🇵 Market holiday — Sports Day
    Monday, 12 October · JPX / TSE
    JPX / TSE closed for Sports Day. Settlement and expiry cycles roll to the next session.
    Source →

  3. 🇺🇸 LULD threshold refresh — new Tier 2 bands
    Thursday, 08 October · Nasdaq
    Revised halt-circuity bands live; expect more lock/limit states in the volatile names.
    Source →


Stay hidden. Stay ahead.
— Goldirham Whisper
